DATA SIMULATION

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#Paramètres de la simulation

# Domaine
I <- c(0, 1)
t_grid <- seq(I[1], I[2], length.out = 200)

# Taille de l'échantillons
N <- 1000

# dimension de l'espace des predicteur
p <- 3
# Nombre de composante
D <- 3

# Empirical study of convergence.
sample_sizes <- seq(100,500,50) 
n_replications <- 1

alphas = c( 0.1, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1)

order_paras0 = c(10, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50)

order_paras1 = seq(0.1,1,0.1)

X_new <- generat_X(p, n = 1, seg = FALSE)
X_new_seg <- runif(1, min = -1, max = 1)

Ds <- c(3, 5, 7, 10)

zero_prop <- 0.2

Vs <- c(1,2,3)

Base <- create_bspline_basis(t_grid, n_basis = 8, degree = 3)
```

#For the polynomial case

```{r, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(123)

KLD_divergence_without_zero <- list()

for (l in 1:length(Vs)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n Pour degree %d \n \n", Vs[l]))
  
  div <- divergence_kld_comp(sample_sizes, n_replications, X_new, Ds, p, zero_prop = 0, Vs[l], seg = FALSE)
  KLD_divergence_without_zero[[l]] <- div
}

saveRDS(KLD_divergence_without_zero, "KLD_divergence_without_zero.rds")
```


```{r, warning=FALSE}

saveRDS(KLD_divergence_with_zero, "KLD_divergence_with_zero.rds")
```

#For the piecewise function case

```{r}
kNN_divergence_with_zero_seg <- divergence_comp(sample_sizes, n_replications, X_new_seg, alphas, order_paras0, Ds, p, mode = 0, zero_prop = zero_prop, v=1, seg = TRUE)

saveRDS(kNN_divergence_with_zero_seg, "kNN_divergence_with_zero_seg.rds")
```

```{r}
kNN_divergence_without_zero_seg <- divergence_comp(sample_sizes, n_replications, X_new_seg, alphas, order_paras0, Ds, p, mode = 0, zero_prop = 0, v=1, seg = TRUE)
```
